about: PoE2 1.0 PREVIEW uniques (every line '1.0 preview, subject to change'). Read only with a request's preview_1_0 switch (builder/preview add_uniques). Lines are poe2db's reveal cards (read 23 Nov 2026), in PoB's raw item text. The reveal shows ONE roll of each line and no ranges: each line is that roll, fixed (MEDIUM; the real ranges are unpublished). 'changed': true = a 0.5.5 unique whose 1.0 text replaces its 0.5.5 text while the switch is on (its 0.5.5 market price kept). New uniques have no market: offered only without a divine cap or in SSF (preview.unique_price). Only uniques on bases PoB already has are here (Oro's Sacrifice, Agnar: Twilight / Vampiric Longsword; Ashcaller: Searing Wand; none in PoB's bases.json bb52d6b368). Granted skills (Perfect Squall, Frostflame, Tasalio's Charge ...) are in no data yet: their lines grant nothing (an UNDERCOUNT, each row's not_modelled).
